recent.title: Recent labs
recent.notFound: This lab is no longer in the browser storage.

share.tooLarge: This lab is too large for a share link ({{size}} of at most {{limit}} characters). Export it as a file instead.
share.corrupt: The share link is damaged or incomplete. Ask for a new link.
share.copyFailed: The link could not be copied to the clipboard.
share.linkTooLong: This share link is too long ({{size}} characters, at most {{limit}}). It is damaged or was not made by Octetlab; ask for the lab file instead.

import.notJson: The file is not valid JSON: {{detail}}
import.notALab: The file is not an Octetlab lab.
import.unsupportedVersion: This lab was saved by a newer version of Octetlab (format {{version}}; this version reads up to {{supported}}). Update the app and try again.
import.invalidVersion: The lab format version "{{version}}" is not valid.
import.migrationFailed: The lab could not be upgraded from format {{version}} to the current format: {{detail}}
import.readFailed: The file could not be read: {{detail}}
import.fileTooLarge: The file is too large to be a lab ({{size}} MB, at most {{limit}} MB).

schema.tooSmall: {{path}}: value too small or too short (minimum {{minimum}}).
schema.tooBig: {{path}}: value too large or too long (maximum {{maximum}}).
schema.reservedId: {{path}}: this id is reserved (__proto__, constructor and prototype cannot be used).

invariant.badInterfaceId: Device "{{deviceId}}": interface "{{portId}}" has a bad or duplicate name.
invariant.invalidBaseMac: Device "{{deviceId}}" has an invalid MAC address.
invariant.duplicateMac: Device "{{deviceId}}", port "{{portId}}": the MAC address is already used by another port.
invariant.vlanOutOfRange: Device "{{deviceId}}": a VLAN id is outside 1–4094.
invariant.vlanOutOfRangeOnPort: Device "{{deviceId}}", interface "{{portId}}": a VLAN id is outside 1–4094.
invariant.missingDefaultVlan: Device "{{deviceId}}": the VLAN database must contain VLAN 1.
invariant.duplicateAclName: Device "{{deviceId}}": two access lists are named "{{name}}".
invariant.aclNumberOutOfRange: Device "{{deviceId}}": access list {{name}} has a number outside the range of its type.
invariant.duplicateAclSeq: Device "{{deviceId}}": access list "{{name}}" has two entries with the same sequence number.
invariant.duplicateNatPool: Device "{{deviceId}}": two NAT pools are named "{{name}}".
invariant.duplicateUser: Device "{{deviceId}}": two local users are named "{{name}}".

invalidLink.unknownDevice: Cable "{{linkId}}" ends on a device that does not exist.
invalidLink.unknownPort: Cable "{{linkId}}" ends on a port that does not exist.
invalidLink.sameDevice: Cable "{{linkId}}" joins a device to itself.
invalidLink.cableDoesNotFitPort: Cable "{{linkId}}" does not fit the port it is plugged into.
invalidLink.wirelessNeedsClientAndRadio: Wireless connection "{{linkId}}" must join a wireless client to a radio.
invalidLink.portInUse: Cable "{{linkId}}" uses a port that already holds another cable.
invalidLink.consoleNeedsTerminal: Console cable "{{linkId}}" must join an end device to a network device.
invalidLink.ssidRequired: Wireless connection "{{linkId}}" has no network name (SSID).
invalidLink.crossoverRequired: Cable "{{linkId}}" needs a crossover cable (auto-MDIX is off on both ends).
invalidLink.straightThroughRequired: Cable "{{linkId}}" needs a straight-through cable (auto-MDIX is off on both ends).
